prompts.label: Patterns you notice
prompts.text: Which urges or emotions showed up on multiple days? Any common triggers?

prompts.label: Skills that helped
prompts.text: List 2–3 skills you actually used. What made them more or less effective?

prompts.label: Skills to practice next week
prompts.text: Pick one under-used skill to rehearse daily for 2–5 minutes.

prompts.label: Relationships
prompts.text: Any repair, boundary, or validation you want to try next week?

prompts.label: Safety
prompts.text: Did safety worsen at any point? What early cues will you watch for next week?

prompts.label: One pattern you noticed
prompts.text: In a sentence or two: what showed up more than once (urges, emotions, situations)?

prompts.label: One skill for next week
prompts.text: Pick one skill or intention to carry into next week (with your therapist if you have one).
